description: This Java source file defines an Android activity called BadBehaviorActivity that includes multiple internal classes, such as broadcast receivers, services, and controllers, which intentionally perform problematic or disruptive actions like hanging, crashing, or flooding broadcasts for testing purposes.

classes.name: BadBehaviorActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that provides various buttons to trigger disruptive behaviors such as crashing, hanging, broadcasting floods, or engaging the activity controller to simulate bad behavior scenarios for testing purposes.

classes.name: BadBehaviorException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception used to crash the main thread intentionally.

classes.name: BadReceiver
classes.description: A broadcast receiver that logs a message and then hangs by sleeping for 20 seconds when it receives a broadcast.

classes.name: BadService
classes.description: A service that logs a message, then hangs for 30 seconds before stopping itself, simulating a problematic service.

classes.name: BadController
classes.description: Implements IActivityController that can delay activity starting process, used for simulating system hangs.

classes.name: ExponentialReceiver
classes.description: A broadcast receiver that, upon receiving a broadcast, sends multiple copies of the same broadcast, creating a flood.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity UI and sets up click listeners for buttons that trigger various disruptive behaviors.

methods.name: activityStarting
methods.description: Part of BadController, called when an activity is starting; can introduce delay and simulate hang.

methods.name: activityResuming
methods.description: Part of BadController, called when an activity resumes.

methods.name: appCrashed
methods.description: Part of BadController, called when an app crashes.

methods.name: appEarlyNotResponding
methods.description: Part of BadController, called when an app is unresponsive.

methods.name: appNotResponding
methods.description: Part of BadController, called when an app is not responding.

methods.name: systemNotResponding
methods.description: Part of BadController, called when the system is unresponsive.
